name: Scoriaceous-Cairn
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait perpetual storm systems, and everything the light never reaches.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on biomass and exotic matter are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
